scope.kind: First independent visual review of the exact eight existing d763 screenshots, with reuse of all eight saved text/exercise DOM contracts.
scope.coverage: Representative coverage: four ZH/EN desktop/mobile text tops, two mobile final-figure-195 horizontal-scroll-end views, and two zero-question exercise views (ZH desktop and EN mobile). Not exhaustive full-page tile inspection.
not_reviewed: Original source pixels, extraction or full-body scientific review
New figure science, geometry, cultural or actual-media review
Unpictured middle and later text/formula regions or full-page tiles
A live published card, publication, promotion or canonical acceptance

first_text_review.disposition: Historical first failure retained; unaffected source coverage, formulas, number order and Chinese PASS reused.

affected_text_review.disposition: Effective bilingual SCI/ZHEN PASS combines the affected English PASS with unchanged first-review PASS results; no science review replay.

independent_figure_review.disposition: Independent original/figure/actual-640 review remains reusable; no originals, figure crops or actual-media images opened here.

technical_recovery.classification: Preserved checker expectation failure, not a displayed-content or scientific failure.
technical_recovery.observed_failure: Visible heading omitted raw Markdown bold delimiters while the checker expected those delimiters.
technical_recovery.existing_packet_recovery: Expected-title wrapper strips only native-renderer-supported bold delimiters; the packet reports no HTML/native replay and no replay of previously completed surfaces.

dom_contract_reuse.method: Read every checks[] entry in the hash-bound packet and assert its counts, media measurements, font minima, clipping/error/overflow state and navigation targets in a read-only Node invocation. Verify each declared HTML, screenshot, native-receipt and first-failure hash. No capture or renderer invocation.
dom_contract_reuse.navigation_qualification: All eight saved jump targets reused. Existing rendered exercise return controls were independently seen in the two requested exercise screenshots; no new click or full navigation interaction is claimed.

screenshots_inspected.name: zh-text-1440-top
screenshots_inspected.observation: Clear bold Chinese heading, secondary printed-page line and readable serif body. Visible two-to-three-sentence groups have distinct spacing; the thin concept divider separates the approaching construction section. No overlapping or horizontally clipped text in this viewport.

screenshots_inspected.name: zh-exercises-1440-zero-questions
screenshots_inspected.observation: Chinese exercise heading and page provenance are legible, with a visible return-to-text button. Empty content agrees with the zero-question contract; no fabricated prompt, answer field or practice item appears.

screenshots_inspected.name: zh-text-390-top
screenshots_inspected.observation: Chinese heading fits and body characters remain clear at mobile width. The visible opening groups keep sentence boundaries and paragraph gaps even when lines wrap; content continuing below the viewport is ordinary vertical reading, not horizontal clipping.

screenshots_inspected.name: zh-text-390-final-figure-scroll-end
screenshots_inspected.observation: The preceding Delta t = |CB|/v1 expression is legible and separate from the figure. At the intentional horizontal end, right-side B1, C, B, N and B2 labels and geometry remain clear; left-hand content is off-screen by the declared scroll layout, not page overflow. The scrollbar is at its right end, the Chinese Figure 195 caption sits below it, and following prose remains outside the figure.

screenshots_inspected.name: en-text-1440-top
screenshots_inspected.observation: The modern English title is Deriving the Law of Refraction of Light, with English printed-page metadata. Serif text and visible two-to-three-sentence groups are clear, with comfortable line spacing and paragraph separation. The retained bilingual Huygens name is body content, not an untranslated heading or navigation control.

screenshots_inspected.name: en-text-390-top
screenshots_inspected.observation: The English title wraps naturally into two lines without overlap. Body words fit the column, and the two-sentence opening and three-sentence historical group retain clear separation at mobile width. No observed tiny type or horizontal truncation.

screenshots_inspected.name: en-text-390-final-figure-scroll-end
screenshots_inspected.observation: English lead-in and the Delta t fraction remain readable above the intentional fixed-width figure scroller. The right-end geometry is clear; Figure 195 is centered below the scrollbar rather than over the image. Following English prose begins below the caption, without collision. This view does not claim simultaneous visibility of the intentionally off-screen left half.

screenshots_inspected.name: en-exercises-390-zero-questions
screenshots_inspected.observation: The English exercise heading wraps cleanly; Printed page 210 and Back to text are localized and legible. No questions or invented interactive practice appear, consistently with the zero-question DOM contract.

assessment.complete_paragraph_grouping_basis: Existing d742 saved-flow PASS and affected-review PASS reused; not a new full-body or full-page visual audit.
assessment.risk_disposition_scope: No material remaining DISPLAY risk found that blocks this card within the original bounded offline scope; this does not approve the whole card or authorize promotion.

remaining_limitations.item: Unpictured middle/later prose and formula placement were not independently visually inspected.
remaining_limitations.reason: Representative screenshot coverage is explicit; complete counts and error/clipping/overflow checks are reused from all eight DOM contracts.

remaining_limitations.item: Live published-card acceptance and live navigation are not established by offline screenshots.
remaining_limitations.reason: They are outside this review and no full-card approval or publication claim is made.
